WITH "charter_schools" AS (SELECT "f"."Charter Funding Type" AS "funding_category", "f"."cdscode", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "enrollment", "f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS "frpm_pct" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s"."cdscode" = "f"."cdscode" WHERE "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "f"."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') AND "s"."statustype" = 'Active'), "school_scores" AS (SELECT "cds", "avgscrread" + "avgscrmath" + "avgscrwrite" AS "combined_sat" FROM "satscores" WHERE "rtype" = 'S') SELECT "c".funding_category, COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."cdscode") AS "charter_school_count", SUM("c".enrollment) AS "total_k12_enrollment", ROUND(AVG("c".frpm_pct * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_frpm_eligible_percentage", ROUND(AVG("sc".combined_sat)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_combined_sat_score" FROM "charter_schools" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "school_scores" AS "sc" ON "sc"."cds" = "c"."cdscode" GROUP BY "c".funding_category LIMIT 501

WITH "customer_totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '2013-01' AND "y".date < '2014-01' GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid), "ranked" AS (SELECT segment, customerid, total_consumption, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rn" FROM "customer_totals"), "minima" AS (SELECT segment, total_consumption FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1) SELECT ROUND(MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME')::NUMERIC - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM')::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND(MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM')::NUMERIC - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM')::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND(MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM')::NUMERIC - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME')::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM "minima" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> '' AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) IN (1974, 1975, 1976) AND "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type IN ('VYBER', 'VYDAJ') LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id), "households" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opening_date", "b".total_amount_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".counterparty_count, 0) AS "outside_bank_counterparties", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a4::BIGINT AS "district_population" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "borrowing" AS "b" ON "b".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice') SELECT account_id, account_opening_date, total_amount_borrowed, outside_bank_counterparties, owner_home_district, district_population, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS "rank" FROM "households" ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT "c".account_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "cd".client_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "cd".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "owner_cl" ON "owner_cl".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "c" ON "c".account_id = "cd".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000) AS "avg_bal" ON "avg_bal".account_id = "c".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "owner_cl".gender = "cl".gender GROUP BY "c".account_id), "gender_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "cl".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "qa".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "a".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "od".client_id WHERE "d".a4::NUMERIC > 100000), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, MAX(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM "gender_districts") SELECT CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' END AS "gender", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS "number_of_districts", a2 AS "district", inhabitants, ROUND(AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY gender)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY gender)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_ratio" FROM "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, a2 ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "dist" ON "dist".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'gold' AND "dist".a4::INTEGER >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount_paid, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "pair_totals") SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount_paid FROM "ranked" WHERE amount_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_clients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".client_id, "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "d".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "d".type = 'OWNER'), "regional_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "q".district_id, "di".a3, "di".a2, "di".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "di".a11, "di".a13 FROM "qualifying_clients" AS "q" INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "q".district_id), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT rd.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "rd".a3 ORDER BY "rd".inhabitants DESC, "rd".a2 ASC) AS "rn" FROM "regional_districts" AS "rd") SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG(a13)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate", MAX(a2) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS "most_populous_district" FROM "ranked_districts" GROUP BY a3 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT a2, a16, a4, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a4::NUMERIC DESC, lower(a2) ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia'), "top_three" AS (SELECT * FROM "ranked" WHERE rn <= 3), "averages" AS (SELECT (SELECT AVG(a16::NUMERIC) FROM "top_three") AS "top_avg", (SELECT AVG(a16::NUMERIC) FROM "district") AS "overall_avg") SELECT "t".a2 AS "district_name", "t".a16 AS "crimes_1996", ROUND("av".top_avg, 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND("av".overall_avg, 2) AS "all_district_average", ROUND("av".top_avg - "av".overall_avg, 2) AS "difference" FROM "top_three" AS "t" CROSS JOIN "averages" AS "av" ORDER BY "t".rn ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."type" AS "card_type", "cl".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT card_type, district_id, district_name, inhabitants, MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS "fewest_inhabitants" FROM "card_districts") SELECT card_type, district_name, inhabitants FROM "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = fewest_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "lit_region" AS (SELECT "a3" FROM "district" WHERE "a2" ILIKE 'Litomerice'), "opened" AS (SELECT "a"."account_id", "a"."district_id", "d"."a2" AS "district_name" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "a"."district_id" WHERE "d"."a3" = (SELECT "a3" FROM "lit_region") AND "a"."date" >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a"."date" < DATE '1997-01-01'), "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t"."account_id") "t"."account_id", "t"."balance" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened" AS "o" ON "o"."account_id" = "t"."account_id" WHERE "t"."date" < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t"."account_id" ASC, "t"."date" DESC, "t"."trans_id" DESC), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "o"."account_id", "o"."district_id", "o".district_name, "l"."balance" FROM "opened" AS "o" LEFT JOIN "latest" AS "l" ON "l"."account_id" = "o"."account_id"), "district_stats" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", ROUND(AVG("balance")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_balance" FROM "account_balances" GROUP BY district_id, district_name), "region_stats" AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG("balance")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_balance" FROM "account_balances"), "top_district" AS (SELECT district_name FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY avg_balance DESC NULLS LAST, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT district_name, account_count, avg_balance, (SELECT avg_balance FROM "region_stats") AS "region_avg_balance", (SELECT district_name FROM "top_district") AS "highest_avg_balance_district" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "a".district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "selected_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a4, "d".a11 FROM "ranked_loans" AS "r" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "r".district_id WHERE "r".rn <= 10) SELECT "d".a4 AS "inhabitants", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "selected_districts" AS "s") AS "average_salary" FROM "selected_districts" AS "d" ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn", ROUND(SUM("t".amount)::NUMERIC / "d".a4::NUMERIC, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount)::NUMERIC / "d".a4::NUMERIC DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM("o".amount) FROM "account" AS "aa" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "aa".account_id WHERE "aa".district_id = "d".district_id), 0)::NUMERIC / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "account" AS "ac" WHERE "ac".district_id = "d".district_id), 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "aa" AS (SELECT "d".account_id, "c".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".client_id = 3541), "tx" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'PRIJEM' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "income", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'VYDAJ' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "expense" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "aa" ON "aa".account_id = "t".account_id GROUP BY "t".account_id), "dp" AS (SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "pop_rank" FROM "district"), "tops" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3, a2, inhabitants FROM "dp" ORDER BY a3 ASC, inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC) SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened_date", "a".frequency, "ad".a2 AS "district_name", "ad".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "ad".district_id = "aa".home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "ad".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tx".income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("tx".expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("tx".income, 0) - COALESCE("tx".expense, 0) AS "net_balance", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "cd" ON "cd".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "cd".a3 = "ad".a3) AS "clients_in_region", "tops".a2 AS "most_populous_district_name", "tops".inhabitants AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", "dp".pop_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "aa" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "aa".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "dp" ON "dp".district_id = "ad".district_id INNER JOIN "tops" ON "tops".a3 = "ad".a3 ORDER BY COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') AS "opening_year", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "accounts_opened", COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG("district_lending".amount_lent_per_account), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "amount" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "a2".district_id, SUM(COALESCE("l2".amount, 0))::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account" AS "a2" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "amount" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l2" ON "l2".account_id = "a2".account_id GROUP BY "a2".district_id) AS "district_lending" ON "district_lending".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') ORDER BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "l".account_id AND "tr".date <= "l".date ORDER BY "tr".date DESC, "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "end_of_day_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 10

WITH "issued_clients" AS (SELECT "cl".client_id, "cl".gender, "cl".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", "ca".issued, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "cl".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cl".birth_date)::INTEGER ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender", "di".account_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "di".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "loan_summary" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) SELECT "ic".client_id, "ic".gender, "ic".birth_date, "ic".card_type, "ic".age_at_issue, COALESCE("ls".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("ls".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ls".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "ic".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COALESCE("ls".number_of_loans, 0) > 0 AND "ic".age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "ic".district_name, "ic".district_average_salary, "ic".age_rank_within_gender FROM "issued_clients" AS "ic" LEFT JOIN "loan_summary" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "ic".account_id ORDER BY "ic".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = 2335 AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "female_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, "ad".a2 AS "district", "ad".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "ad" ON "ad".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "ranked" AS (SELECT fl.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "female_loans" AS "fl"), "chosen" AS (SELECT * FROM "ranked" WHERE amount_rank <= 3), "account_stats" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'PRIJEM' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "region_loan_counts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "region_loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "region_salaries" AS (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_district_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) SELECT "ch".client_id, "ch".amount AS "loan_amount", "ch".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("ch".payments * "ch".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("ch".payments * "ch".duration - "ch".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "ch".status AS "loan_status", "ch".district, "ch".region, COALESCE("ast".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "ch".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("ast".total_deposits, 0) > "ch".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rlc".region_loan_count, "rs".avg_district_salary, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-10-09') - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ch".birth_date) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("ch".birth_date, 'MMDD') > '1009' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "completed_age" FROM "chosen" AS "ch" LEFT JOIN "account_stats" AS "ast" ON "ast".account_id = "ch".account_id INNER JOIN "region_loan_counts" AS "rlc" ON "rlc".region = "ch".region INNER JOIN "region_salaries" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "ch".region ORDER BY "ch".amount DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("a".account_id) AS "monthly_statement_accounts_opened_1997", COUNT(DISTINCT "d".district_id) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "d".a4::NUMERIC >= 100000 LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'PRIJEM' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_amount_received", SUM(CASE WHEN "t".type = 'VYDAJ' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_amount_withdrawn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "ga" ON "ga".account_id = "t".account_id GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_counts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "ga" ON "ga".account_id = "l".account_id GROUP BY "l".account_id), "external_counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "number_of_external_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gold_accounts" AS "ga" ON "ga".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "ga".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("ec".number_of_external_counterparties, 0) AS "number_of_external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("ec".number_of_external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ga".district_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "ga".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_counts" AS "lc" ON "lc".account_id = "ga".account_id LEFT JOIN "external_counterparties" AS "ec" ON "ec".account_id = "ga".account_id ORDER BY rank ASC, "ga".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '1996-12-31')::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date)::INT - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "c".birth_date), EXTRACT(DAY FROM "c".birth_date)) > (12, 31) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age_years" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date <= DATE '1996-12-31'), "card_counts" AS (SELECT "dp".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "card_count" FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "cd".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "dp".account_id), "loan_stats" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status = 'B') THEN 'defaulted' WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status IN ('C', 'D')) THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing" FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "l".account_id), "activity" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER')), 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE(MAX("t".balance), 0) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "t".account_id), "profiles" AS (SELECT "ta".account_id, "ta".opened_date, "ta".gender, "ta".age_years, COALESCE("cc".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("ls".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("ls".loan_standing, 'no loan') AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("ac".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ac".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("ac".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("ac".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance" FROM "target_accounts" AS "ta" LEFT JOIN "card_counts" AS "cc" ON "cc".account_id = "ta".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_stats" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "ta".account_id LEFT JOIN "activity" AS "ac" ON "ac".account_id = "ta".account_id) SELECT account_id, opened_date, gender, age_years, card_count, loan_count, loan_standing, transaction_count, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "profiles" ORDER BY peak_balance_rank ASC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id, "d".client_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'classic'), "district_clients" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, "qa".account_id, "qa".client_id FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "qa".account_id), "client_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS "client_count" FROM "district_clients" GROUP BY district_id), "payment_stats" AS (SELECT "dc".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "external_accounts", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "district_clients" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "dc".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "dc".district_id) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COALESCE("cc".client_count, 0) AS "client_count", COALESCE("ps".external_accounts, 0) AS "external_accounts", COALESCE("ps".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "client_counts" AS "cc" ON "cc".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "payment_stats" AS "ps" ON "ps".district_id = "d".district_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C' LIMIT 501

SELECT cohort, ROUND(AVG(avg_salary)) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort' ELSE 'old cohort' END AS "cohort", "d".a11::NUMERIC AS "avg_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date <= DATE '1919-12-31') AS "cohorts" GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY CASE WHEN cohort = 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((("r853".speed - "r854".speed) / "r854".speed) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM (SELECT CAST(fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) AS "speed" FROM "results" INNER JOIN "drivers" ON "results".driverid = "drivers".driverid WHERE raceid = 853 AND forename = 'Paul' AND surname = 'di Resta') AS "r853" CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) AS "speed" FROM "results" INNER JOIN "drivers" ON "results".driverid = "drivers".driverid WHERE raceid = 854 AND forename = 'Paul' AND surname = 'di Resta') AS "r854" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".positionorder <> 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "r".raceid = "ra".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "ra".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_driver_standings_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "d".driverid GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".positionorder = 1) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND((("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds)::NUMERIC / "last_finisher".milliseconds) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_shorter" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".positionorder = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "last_finisher".laps = (SELECT MAX("res".laps) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid) AND "last_finisher".milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND "last_finisher".positionorder = (SELECT MAX("res".positionorder) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".laps = (SELECT MAX("res2".laps) FROM "results" AS "res2" WHERE "res2".raceid = "r".raceid)) LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".laps = "w".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "d" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "dr" ON "dr".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "d".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "w" ON "w".raceid = "d".raceid AND "w".positionorder = 1 WHERE "dr".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds)::NUMERIC / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".positionorder = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "res".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("res".points) AS "score", "c".name, "c".nationality FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "ci" ON "ci".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "res".constructorid WHERE "ci".name = 'Circuit de Monaco' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "r".year = 2008 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".driverid = "d".driverid GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname ORDER BY MIN("l".milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "c".name, TO_CHAR((MIN("lt".milliseconds) * INTERVAL '1 millisecond'), 'MI:SS.MS') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "circuits" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "lt" ON "lt".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "c".country = 'Italy' GROUP BY "c".circuitid, "c".name LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".driverid) AS "pit_stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".circuitid NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT circuitid FROM "races" WHERE year = 2000) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_pit_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob, COUNT(*) AS "q3_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'German' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1971-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1986-01-01' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob ORDER BY q3_times DESC, "d".dob ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::DECIMAL * 1000) ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "lucas" AS (SELECT "q".raceid, "q".position FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "r".year = 2010 AND "q".position IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "lucas" AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2010 AND "q".position IS NOT NULL AND "q".position > "l".position LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 = '1:34.660' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(*) AS "runner_up_count" FROM "races" AS "ra" INNER JOIN "results" AS "re" ON "re".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "re".driverid WHERE "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "re".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "r".time AS "local_clock_time", "d".url FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND "res".positionorder = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q3 = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT "q2".q2 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q2 <> '' GROUP BY "q2".q2 ORDER BY MIN(split_part("q2".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60000 + split_part("q2".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC * 1000) ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 < '1:40.000' LIMIT 501

WITH "longest" AS (SELECT MAX("p".milliseconds) AS "max_ms" FROM "pitstops" AS "p") SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".duration FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "longest" AS "l" ON "p".milliseconds = "l".max_ms INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(driver_q3_count), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times_per_driver" FROM (SELECT "d".driverid, COUNT("q".q3) AS "driver_q3_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid) AS "per_driver" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS "shared_names" ON "shared_names".forename = "d".forename WHERE "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "d".code IS NULL AND "q".q1 > '02:00.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, SUM("res".points) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM "laptimes") AS "lt" ON "lt".driverid = "res".driverid AND "lt".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref ORDER BY "d".driverref ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "french_editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".date FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".year >= 1990 AND "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "c".country = 'France'), "driver_fastest" AS (SELECT "fe".raceid, "fe".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, MIN("lt".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "lt" ON "lt".raceid = "fe".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "lt".driverid GROUP BY "fe".raceid, "fe".date, "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname), "qualifying_rows" AS (SELECT date, forename, surname, TO_CHAR(TIME '00:00:00' + fastest_ms * INTERVAL '1 millisecond', 'MI:SS.MS') AS "lap_time" FROM "driver_fastest" WHERE fastest_ms < 90000), "editions_without_qualifier" AS (SELECT "fe".date, NULL::TEXT AS "forename", NULL::TEXT AS "surname", NULL::TEXT AS "lap_time" FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "driver_fastest" AS "df" WHERE "df".raceid = "fe".raceid AND "df".fastest_ms < 90000)) SELECT date, forename, surname, lap_time FROM (SELECT * FROM "qualifying_rows" UNION ALL SELECT * FROM "editions_without_qualifier") AS "rows" ORDER BY date ASC, surname ASC NULLS LAST, forename ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_lap_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "q".q3, "d".forename, "d".surname, "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d".dob) > 1980 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '') SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS "driver_full_name", race_name, race_year, q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "eligible" WHERE (EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM q3::INTERVAL) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM q3::INTERVAL)) = (SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM q3::INTERVAL) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM q3::INTERVAL)) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

WITH "driver_race_best" AS (SELECT "l".raceid, "l".driverid, MIN("l".milliseconds) AS "best_lap_ms" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".raceid, "l".driverid), "ranked" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY best_lap_ms ASC) AS "lap_rank" FROM "driver_race_best") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ranked".driverid) AS "count" FROM "ranked" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ranked".driverid WHERE "ranked".lap_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "season_points" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, MAX("cs".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid GROUP BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year), "career" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("sp".season_points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "season_points" AS "sp" ON "sp".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT career.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".positionorder = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501
