SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p"."admission" = '+' THEN "p"."id" END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id"), 0), 2) AS "percentage_inpatients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."birthday" >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p"."birthday" < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "rnp"::INTEGER END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory"), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."id", "l"."date", "l"."T-BIL" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER = "s".max_rnp), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_bilirubin" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL", "c"."date", "c"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "highest" AS "h" ON "c"."T-BIL" = "h".max_bilirubin INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "c"."id" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis IS NOT NULL) AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256')) LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "patient_titers" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "l".id), "top_titer" AS (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) AS "highest_titer" FROM "patient_titers") SELECT "pt".id, "pt".anti_rnp_titer FROM "patient_titers" AS "pt" CROSS JOIN "top_titer" AS "tt" WHERE "pt".anti_rnp_titer = "tt".highest_titer LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lp" ON "lp"."id" = "p"."id" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lr" ON "lr"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'MCTD' AND "lp"."plt" BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "lr"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "lr"."rnp"::INTEGER > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT sex, ROUND(AVG(test_date_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".date) AS "test_date_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) AS "patient_counts" GROUP BY sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."DNA-II" AS "anti_dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l"."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, anti_dna_level, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY anti_dna_level DESC) AS "level_rank" FROM "eligible") SELECT id, date, anti_dna_level FROM "ranked" WHERE level_rank = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "p"."id" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h"."id" = "p"."id" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" = '-' AND "h"."hct" IS NOT NULL AND ("h"."hct" <= 29 OR "h"."hct" >= 52) AND "r"."rnp" IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY "p"."id") AS "qualified" LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("l"."rnp") AS "highest anti-RNP value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 64) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest_age_in_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

WITH "target_patients" AS (SELECT "id" FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis')), "per_patient" AS (SELECT "tp"."id", COUNT("l"."id") AS "test_count" FROM "target_patients" AS "tp" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l"."id" = "tp"."id" GROUP BY "tp"."id") SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "target_patients" AS "tp" ON "tp"."id" = "l"."id") AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE test_count = 0) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "per_patient" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|[, ])SLE([, ]|$)' AND "e".thrombosis > 0 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" GROUP BY id) AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id AS "patient ID", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 300 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('>=300', '>=1000')) ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%RA%' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".cre >= 1.5) AS "patients_with_high_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".cre >= 1.5) / COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT admission, "T-CHO", id FROM (SELECT "p".admission, "l"."T-CHO", "l".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '+') UNION ALL SELECT "p".admission, "l"."T-CHO", "l".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-')) AS "u" ORDER BY CASE WHEN admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "l".rnp, CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE "l".rnp::INTEGER END AS "rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, rnp, rnp_level, MAX(rnp_level) OVER () AS "max_level" FROM "eligible") SELECT DISTINCT id, rnp AS "anti_rnp_level" FROM "ranked" WHERE rnp_level = max_level LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("hct") AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "hct" IS NOT NULL AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "U-PRO" = '4') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ra IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_sample" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_scl70" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "latest_sample".id FROM "latest_sample" INNER JOIN "latest_scl70" ON "latest_sample".id = "latest_scl70".id WHERE "latest_sample".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "latest_scl70".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ssa".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "ssa" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein" ON "protein".id = "ssa".id WHERE "ssa".ssa IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM("ssa".ssa)) NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "protein"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM("protein"."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('-', 'none') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna < '8' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."admission" <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."id" = "p"."id" AND "l"."alp" >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre < 1.5 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp = (SELECT MAX(rnp) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "highest_anti_rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hgb < 10 GROUP BY id) AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::INTEGER END) FROM "laboratory") LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_lab" AS (SELECT id, got, rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date ASC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "ranked_lab" WHERE rn = 1 AND got < 60 AND CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::INTEGER > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, date, "U-PRO" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp NOT IN ('negative', '0', '1', '4') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp <> '0' AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')), "normal_gpt" AS (SELECT "e".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_gpt" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id HAVING BOOL_AND("l".gpt < 60)) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "normal_gpt" AS "n" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "n".id ORDER BY "n".highest_gpt DESC, "n".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "elevated" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) SELECT "e".care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "x".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "x".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "elevated" AS "x" ON "x".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".care_setting ORDER BY "e".care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) AS "latest" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "latest".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "latest".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l"."DNA-II") AS "highest_anti_dna" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l"."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis HAVING MAX("l"."DNA-II") = (SELECT MAX("l2"."DNA-II") FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2"."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC), "setting_counts" AS (SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(*) AS "patients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "li".igg > 900 AND "li".igg < 2000) AS "normal_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission) SELECT CASE admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting", ROUND(100.0 * normal_patients / patients, 1) AS "percentage" FROM "setting_counts" ORDER BY CASE admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_visits" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_rnp" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_visits" AS "v" ON "l".id = "v".id AND "l".date = "v".latest_date), "qualifying" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_rnp" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "qualifying" LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "latest" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

WITH "confirmed_sle" AS (SELECT "admission" FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "diagnosis" NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%'), "counts" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '-') AS "outpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" IN ('+', '-')) AS "care_setting_total" FROM "confirmed_sle") SELECT inpatients, outpatients, ROUND(100.0 * inpatients / NULLIF(care_setting_total, 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "high_ldh" ON "high_ldh".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') GROUP BY id) AS "proteinuria" ON "proteinuria".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' END AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_aCL_IgM" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND (' ' || REPLACE("e".diagnosis, ',', ' ') || ' ') LIKE '% SjS %' AND "e".diagnosis NOT LIKE '% susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp = '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "normal_sm" ON "normal_sm".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "proteinuria" ON "proteinuria".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "normal_sm".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "proteinuria"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc IS NOT NULL AND (rbc <= 3.5 OR rbc >= 6.0) GROUP BY id) AS "abnormal_rbc" ON "abnormal_rbc".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp NOT IN ('0', 'negative') GROUP BY id) AS "positive_rnp" ON "positive_rnp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "positive_rnp" ON "positive_rnp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 15 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('', '-', '0') AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("l".date, 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 50 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'o' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a"."molecule_id" IN (SELECT "b"."molecule_id" FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b"."bond_type" = '#') AND "a"."molecule_id" IN (SELECT "a2"."molecule_id" FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2"."element" IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / COUNT(*), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_atom_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_saturation" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type <> '-') AS "all_single" FROM "molecule" AS "m") SELECT all_single, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "count_difference" FROM "molecule_saturation" GROUP BY all_single ORDER BY all_single DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_molecules" AS (SELECT molecule_id FROM "molecule" WHERE label = '+'), "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".atom_id, "a".element, "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "plus_molecules" AS "pm" ON "pm".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id), "most_common" AS (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "bonded_atoms" GROUP BY element), "top_elements" AS (SELECT element, bonded_atom_count FROM "most_common" WHERE bonded_atom_count = (SELECT MAX(bonded_atom_count) FROM "most_common")), "all_plus_atoms" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "all_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "plus_molecules" AS "pm" ON "pm".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id) SELECT "te".element, ROUND(100.0 * "te".bonded_atom_count / "apa".all_atom_count, 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "top_elements" AS "te" CROSS JOIN "all_plus_atoms" AS "apa" LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') + COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a2".element = 'cl') AS "count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "neighbor".atom_id) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "sulfur" ON "sulfur".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "sulfur".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "neighbor" ON "neighbor".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "sulfur".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "n" ON "n".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "n".element = 'n' WHERE "m".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a1".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS "label", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id)) OVER (), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "rare_elements" AS (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1), "qualifying_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element), "qualifying_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "qa".molecule_id FROM "qualifying_atoms" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "qa".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonds_per_molecule" AS (SELECT "qm".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "qualifying_molecules" AS "qm" INNER JOIN "qualifying_atoms" AS "qa" ON "qa".molecule_id = "qm".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "qa".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "qa".atom_id GROUP BY "qm".molecule_id) SELECT molecule_id, bond_count FROM "bonds_per_molecule" ORDER BY molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "carbon_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, "ac".number_of_atoms, COALESCE("bc".number_of_bonds, 0) AS "number_of_bonds", "ac".carbon_atoms, "ac".chlorine_atoms, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "multiple_bonds", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, "ac".number_of_atoms DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atoms > 0) SELECT rank, molecule_id, label, number_of_atoms, number_of_bonds, carbon_atoms, chlorine_atoms, carbon_touching_bonds, multiple_bonds FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "yt" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".molecule_id = "yt".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON ("c".atom_id = "h".atom_id AND "c".atom_id2 <> "h".atom_id) OR ("c".atom_id2 = "h".atom_id AND "c".atom_id <> "h".atom_id) INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other_end" ON "other_end".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END WHERE "yt".element = 'y' AND "h".element = 'h' AND "other_end".molecule_id = "yt".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND (("a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element <> 'c') OR ("a2".element = 'c' AND "a1".element <> 'c')) GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "number_of_element_pairs", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT "c".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) = 0) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element AS "element", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
